\texttt{DEBUG\_\allowbreak{}TRACE} & completion of a TF-selected trace unit & completed trace unit & \texttt{BASIC} & none\\
\texttt{BREAKPOINT} & BKPT & BKPT completed & \texttt{BASIC} & none\\
\texttt{ILLEGAL\_\allowbreak{}INSTRUCTION} & decode or instruction-validity check & no effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{ERROR} & error code\\
\texttt{PRIVILEGE\_\allowbreak{}FAULT} & privilege check & no effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{BASIC} & none\\
\texttt{PAGE\_\allowbreak{}FAULT} & segment, translation, access, or atomic-alignment check & no effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{PAGE\_\allowbreak{}FAULT} & error code, fault EA, and linear address\\
\texttt{DIVIDE\_\allowbreak{}ERROR} & integer divide operation & no effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{ERROR} & error code\\
\texttt{INVALID\_\allowbreak{}CONTROL\_\allowbreak{}STATE} & control-state validation & no effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{ERROR} & error code\\
\texttt{FLOATING\_\allowbreak{}POINT\_\allowbreak{}FAULT} & enabled floating-point exception & no destination or accrued-flag effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{ERROR} & error code\\
\texttt{DOUBLE\_\allowbreak{}FAULT} & architectural event-delivery failure & no partial first delivery state & \texttt{AUXILIARY} & delivery-failure auxiliary state\\
\texttt{MACHINE\_\allowbreak{}CHECK} & processor or memory-system machine-check source & selected by PRECISE and RETRY\_SAFE & \texttt{AUXILIARY} & machine-check auxiliary state\\
\texttt{BUS\_\allowbreak{}ERROR} & synchronous acknowledged bus failure & no CPU state effects of the faulting instruction & \texttt{AUXILIARY} & bus-error auxiliary state\\
\texttt{NMI} & admitted non-maskable interrupt source & all earlier committed state & \texttt{BASIC} & none\\
\texttt{INTERRUPT} & admitted maskable interrupt source & all earlier committed state & \texttt{BASIC} & none\\
